name: Fetch English locale strings
description: Call this when the application needs the English translation strings for the meetings UI (e.g., when rendering the offer page). Use a language‑specific endpoint (e.g., /assets/locales/fr.json) instead when a different locale is required.

nocache.description: Cache‑busting query parameter; optional and can be any timestamp or identifier.

outputs.description: A JSON object containing translation keys and their English strings. Nested objects may represent grouped translations.
